verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Organizations feature inside a realm and realm-level tenant isolation. It can also broker logins to external OIDC/SAML identity providers configured in the admin console, and one team reports running many external IdPs for SSO. That covers per-customer SSO connections in principle. However, the evidence never shows an IdP bound to a specific organization, domain verification, or users being created automatically on first federated login. missing for 10: verified/owned domain configuration per organization, explicit just-in-time user provisioning on first IdP login, documentation linking identity providers to organizations, independent hands-on corroboration of the org-SSO flow.
